props.text: Traditional massage is a firm, full-body massage with warm oil that uses kneading and focused pressure to release muscle tension. It works more directly on stiff or overworked areas than a lighter relaxation massage such as Balinese massage.

items.question: What is traditional massage?
items.answer: Traditional massage is a hands-on massage technique that uses firm pressure, kneading and focused movements to help release muscle tension and improve body comfort. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, it is a full-body massage with warm oil. Sessions run from 30 minutes to 2 hours.

items.question: How is traditional massage different from Balinese massage?
items.answer: Traditional massage usually uses firmer and more direct pressure for muscle release, while Balinese massage combines flowing strokes, stretching and relaxation-focused techniques. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, 1 hour of traditional massage costs IDR 169.000 per person and 1 hour of Balinese massage IDR 159.000. Both are also available at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Is traditional massage painful?
items.answer: Traditional massage can feel strong, especially around tense areas, but the pressure should remain comfortable. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, therapists check your comfort as they move from one area to another and adjust the intensity to your preference, so tell them straight away if anything feels too strong.

items.question: Is traditional massage good for a first massage?
items.answer: Yes. First-time guests can enjoy a traditional massage at Spa Bali Moon because your therapist adjusts the pressure to your comfort and checks in as the session goes on. Thirty minutes suits one tense area; 1 hour suits mild muscle stiffness.

items.question: Should I choose traditional massage or deep tissue massage?
items.answer: Choose traditional massage if you want firm full-body pressure and general muscle relief; deep tissue massage is more targeted toward deeper layers and specific long-term tension areas. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, 1 hour costs IDR 169.000 per person for traditional massage and IDR 269.000 for deep tissue massage.

items.question: How much does a traditional massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A traditional massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 90.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 169.000 for 1 hour, IDR 259.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 339.000 for 2 hours per person. The 30-minute session shares our lowest massage price with the 30-minute back massage. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: How long does a traditional massage take?
items.answer: A traditional massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 30 minutes (IDR 90.000), 1 hour (IDR 169.000), 1.5 hours (IDR 259.000) or 2 hours (IDR 339.000) per person.

items.question: Can I have a traditional massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen, oils and everything a traditional massage needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book a traditional massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my traditional massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your traditional massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
